objective: Identify a psoriasis-derived, treatment-reversible human gene program that transfers to RA fibroblasts and reverses in an independent RA synovial treatment cohort, with comprehensive bounded novelty.
non_negotiable_order: source feasibility and GPL570 identifier audit
non-RA source-only gene and module generation
RA development in two independent study families
single opening of GSE24742 terminal numeric values

source_non_ra.design: baseline lesional versus non-lesional paired biopsies; randomized secukinumab versus placebo at week 12

ra_terminal_holdout.design: 12 paired RA synovial biopsies before and 12 weeks after rituximab

identifier_policy.eligible_probe: official annotation has exactly one non-empty Gene symbol with no multi-symbol delimiter
identifier_policy.gene_expression: arithmetic mean of all eligible probes mapped to the gene
identifier_policy.cross_platform_gene_eligibility: gene symbol is present in both RA development gene universes and has at least one eligible GPL570 probe

source_gene_analysis.baseline_contrast: paired BL.LS minus BL.NL across all donors with both samples
source_gene_analysis.week12_contrast: mean within-donor W12.LS-minus-BL.LS change in Secukinumab minus the corresponding change in Placebo
source_gene_analysis.week52_support: paired W52.LS minus BL.LS within the original Secukinumab arm; supportive only

tests.baseline: two-sided one-sample t test plus Wilcoxon sensitivity
tests.week12: two-sided Welch t test plus 10000-label permutation with seed 20260814

source_gene_analysis.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across all feasible genes separately for baseline and week12
source_gene_analysis.priority_score: minimum of baseline paired standardized effect and absolute week12 treatment standardized effect, plus 0.05 times the sum of negative log10 baseline and week12 BH q values

source_module_generation.universe: all four-gene combinations from the 40 source-priority genes
source_module_generation.score: equal mean of gene-wise z scores within each source analysis sample set
source_module_generation.ranking: descending minimum absolute standardized baseline/week12 module effect, then descending median pairwise correlation, then lexicographic gene tuple

ra_development.normalization: median-of-ratios size factors, log2(normalized count plus 0.5), gene-wise z within cohort, equal four-gene mean
ra_development.primary_test: two-sided Welch t test of RA versus control
ra_development.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across the complete 600-module source-frozen family separately in each RA cohort

matched_random.matching: gene mean-expression quintile by gene variance quintile within cohort

ra_development.portfolio_ranking: ascending Fisher combined p across the two RA cohorts, then ascending maximum cohort BH q, then descending source module rank score, then lexicographic gene tuple
ra_development.redundancy_rule: greedy selection permits at most two shared genes between any two selected modules

terminal_holdout.scoring: same frozen GPL570 gene-probe map; gene-wise z across the 24 holdout samples; equal four-gene mean
terminal_holdout.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across every module in the frozen confirmatory portfolio for paired-t and exact sign-flip p values separately
terminal_holdout.formal_selection: among all family-adjusted pass candidates choose ascending maximum of the two BH q values, then most negative effect, then frozen portfolio rank
terminal_holdout.formal_overall_pass_count: 1 if at least one candidate passes, otherwise 0

dimensions: all four three-gene subsets in RA
all six gene pairs in RA or synovial fibroblasts
novelty.acceptable_class: N1 or N2 with no prior exact program and no prior identical causal/intervention chain
novelty.claim_boundary: bounded literature audit cannot certify universal absence

prohibitions: reading GSE24742 target expression before portfolio freeze
changing source family after RA values are read
changing portfolio after GSE24742 values are read
dropping failed candidates from the confirmatory multiplicity family
changing gene weights, direction, thresholds, tests, sample pairing or probe mapping after numeric authorization
using glycolysis as the title or candidate-generating claim
declaring single-gene causality from a program-level pass
